name: Agent CLI
responsibility: Authors named models: one short-lived process per command, run by the source of the checkout it stands in or by the installed release, writing no model itself
description: Every model operation reaches the Archboard server over HTTP and names the vault the command found, from -C or the checkout it runs in. The first command in a checkout or untracked vault that this machine does not know registers it. Three commands draw for themselves in a headless browser here: rasterize photographs the SVG the server made; record keeps a narrated talk from the server's own page, then draws it frame by frame and has ffmpeg encode the video; replay draws a kept talk again. repo add, repo use, repo forget and repo language-server write this machine's list of checkouts itself. With --clipboard, rasterize publishes PNG and self-contained HTML to the local desktop through a native clipboard helper. A release is one compiled executable that runs this CLI. Started with its internal first argument it runs the server instead (ADR 0076).
